# Debian routing follow-up uses the producer task kind of its own revision

Fresh full two-file36-line follow-up diff read. It changes target.deb from release-deb-repackage to repackage in both candidate and Nightly artifact manifests. No artifact filename, platform list, package template or upload code changes here. The literal producer kind is part of artifact routing; it is not a stylistic spelling change or proof that an FTP upload completed. Published fixed manifest proofs from2356 are reused with exact Git-body checks. Fixed candidates and Nightly target.deb now select repackage-deb for linux64. The separately inspected current producer kind defines repackage-deb, promote phase, signed build/toolchain dependencies and debian12-repackage image. Those later current kind/platform details are not attributed to this historical repackage intermediate spelling. No graph generation, image, package, FTP upload, installation or runtime test ran.

Scope: Debian artifact producer mapping.
